about: Calgary is Alberta’s largest city, at the confluence of the Bow and Elbow rivers in the Rocky Mountain foothills. It is a major energy and corporate centre with a compact downtown of office towers. Neighbourhoods spread across a large prairie-foothills grid, with the mountains visible to the west. About 1.3 million people live in the city proper.
seoSummary: Alberta’s largest city, an energy centre in the Rocky Mountain foothills.
knownFor: Proximity to Banff and the Rockies
Chinook winds and a relatively dry climate
